program: Curl focus: clean reps over heavy reps

rules.load_policy: Weights stay constant: 35 lb dumbbells, no load changes. The coach never recommends adding or dropping weight.
rules.progression: Progress = more clean reps at 35 lb. If every rep in all sets stays clean at 12, the next goal is 12 clean reps on the slower tempo, not more weight.
rules.fatigue_signal: If the delt takes over before rep 6 in two sets in a row, cut the set short at the first cheat and rest longer (no weight change).
rules.imbalance_target: Keep R/L biceps share between 0.45 and 0.55.
rules.cut_adjustment: On a 500 kcal cut: hold the weight rather than chase progression; a set where effort per rep (%MVC) stays steady and reps stay clean counts as a win. Expect fatigue (delt takeover) earlier than when eating at maintenance; call it out, don't punish it.
